newsitem.title: UK: NWE products - steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE products - steady to firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products ended the week mixed, dealers said.
Gasoline barges were broadly steady around $182-184 fob, but cargoes were $1 stronger after recent arbs to the U.S. and talk of less refinery output.
Spot gas oil prices were mixed with slack demand pressuring barge premiums while cargo prices were mostly stable though diesel lost some ground.
0.2 sulphur cargo premiums for all July deliveries were firm around August IPE +$1.50/+$2 cif NWE while diesel valued around August IPE +$4.00 off 50 cents.

High sulphur fuel oil barges ended steady at $86.50 fob ARA after touching earlier highs, with a trader cutting his price for prompt material. High sulphur cracked cargoes were offered steady on low supply at two means plus $1.50 but no buyers were seen at that price for the Russian M-100. One percent was also unchanged at $92/$94 with supply and demand said balanced.
